title: The Toxic Lake
summary: Xiao Yan falls through the floor into a strange space under the altar where flying is banned, and the Sea's Core Vest that Yun Zhi gave him saves him from the fall. Above, Mo Ba Si, leader of the Mo Snake Tribe, arrives with reinforcements and fights Gu He's group. Gu He senses the flame's scent from four places and leads his group toward the weakest. Xiao Yan and Yao Lao cross a highly toxic lake under the Bone Chilling Flame to an island, but the Green Lotus Core Flame there is a fake. Following the real scent, Xiao Yan finds Queen Medusa in her true snake form about to swallow the Heavenly Flame. Yao Lao explains she risks death to become a Dou Zong and lead her people back to their homeland. Xiao Yan sees himself in her, and waits for her weakest moment to strike.
events: Xiao Yan's Purple Cloud Wings fail under a flight ban; the Sea's Core Vest saves him.
Snake guards attack Gu He's group; Mo Ba Si of the Mo Snake Tribe arrives.
Gu He senses four flame scents and heads for the weakest one with Ms. Yun.
Xiao Yan crosses a toxic lake inside the Bone Chilling Flame; the flame on the island is a fake.
Xiao Yan follows the real scent and finds Medusa, who sees him but lets him be.
Medusa takes her original form and starts to swallow the Heavenly Flame.
Yao Lao explains the Snakemen's exile and Medusa's wish to lead them home; Xiao Yan waits to strike.
introduced: Snakemen's original form (snake beast soul merged at birth)
